job.title: Rehau IT Project Manager SAP Commerce (mwd)

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Consultant | SAP Certified | Project Management & Integration Specialist
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs, with a proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integration and data pipeline optimization. I bridge the gap between business and IT by translating complex requirements into functional specifications and user stories. Experienced in leading agile teams, managing international stakeholders, and utilizing AI-assisted delivery to ensure high-quality, scalable platform performance.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Rehau IT Project Manager SAP Commerce (mwd)
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of experience delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud projects for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to REHAU’s digital transformation. My background as a techno-functional consultant allows me to align complex technical architectures with business objectives effectively.

bullets.label: Project Delivery
bullets.text: I have successfully led the design and implementation of SAP Commerce Cloud (2211) solutions, managing the full lifecycle from requirements analysis to production support.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: I specialize in architecting data flows between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, ensuring seamless synchronization across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: I bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams by translating business needs into functional specifications and actionable user stories.

bullets.label: Agile Execution
bullets.text: I have extensive experience working in agile environments, managing international teams, and utilizing AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and documentation.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period, with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and availability starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience aligns with your project goals.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Rehau IT Project Manager SAP Commerce (mwd)
cover_de.hook: Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen für Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell möchte ich REHAU bei der digitalen Transformation unterstützen. Als techno-funktionaler Berater verbinde ich komplexe technische Architekturen mit Ihren geschäftlichen Anforderungen.

bullets.label: Projektumsetzung
bullets.text: Ich habe erfolgreich SAP Commerce Cloud (2211) Lösungen entworfen und implementiert, wobei ich den gesamten Lebenszyklus von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zum Support verantwortet habe.

bullets.label: Integrationskompetenz
bullets.text: Ich bin spezialisiert auf die Architektur von Datenflüssen zwischen PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Systemen, um eine nahtlose Synchronisation über globale Kanäle hinweg sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Führung
bullets.text: Ich fungiere als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen und IT, indem ich Geschäftsanforderungen in präzise funktionale Spezifikationen und User Stories übersetze.

bullets.label: Agile Arbeitsweise
bullets.text: Ich verfüge über umfassende Erfahrung in agilen Teams, der Steuerung internationaler Stakeholder und dem Einsatz von KI-gestützten Tools zur Effizienzsteigerung.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein aktuelles Arbeitsverhältnis endet am 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung stehe. Gerne stelle ich mich Ihnen in einem persönlichen Gespräch vor.

tailoring.why_company: REHAU stands for innovation and quality in polymer-based solutions, and I am impressed by your commitment to digitalizing the customer experience. I want to bring my deep SAP Commerce expertise to your team to help optimize your e-commerce ecosystem, improve integration efficiency, and ensure that your digital platforms remain scalable and high-performing as you continue to grow globally.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by solving complex integration challenges and delivering high-impact e-commerce solutions that directly improve business outcomes and user experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Developer with 5+ years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud and techno-functional consulting. I am very interested in the IT Project Manager role at REHAU and would love to discuss how my background can support your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Rehau IT Project Manager SAP Commerce (mwd) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the IT Project Manager SAP Commerce position at REHAU. With over 5 years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, PIM/ERP integrations, and techno-functional consulting, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team's success. I am currently serving my notice period and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of an interview.
